name: webapp-factory
description: A Claude Code plugin to spec, plan, implement and review web applications (front, API, database) with a disciplined, reviewed workflow.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: The workflow: /factory:factory-init sets up the project, then write-spec, write-plan, implement, grill-me, review and retro run the spec → plan → code → review → close loop, driven by the project's factory.yaml manifest.

plugins.name: factory-board
plugins.description: A mod (function hooks) for the factory: a pane that lists the project's features, their dev plans and the stages running in other sessions, and prepares the next /factory: prompt with one button.
